lyrics:
[Intro: bright synth hook, steady drum machine, pulsing bass]

[Verse 1: smooth, light, rueful]
You were laughing at a table by the door
Wearing something I had never seen before
I raised a hand like a fool who'd been forgiven
You looked right through me like a window

[Pre-Chorus: pads swell, falsetto]
And I stood there with my drink and my nerve
Getting just what I deserve

[Chorus: full beat, synth hook answers, doubled voice]
You looked right through me
Like I was weather, like I was glass
I had it coming, I know, I know
I made you cry and I let it pass
Now I'm the ghost at the party
You looked right through me
Good for you

[Verse 2: smooth, lower]
I remember what I said and how I said it
I remember that you asked and I just let it
Go, like it was nothing, like a coat I didn't need
Funny what a person leaves

[Pre-Chorus: pads swell, falsetto]
And I stood there with my drink and my nerve
Getting just what I deserve

[Chorus: full beat, synth hook answers, doubled voice]
You looked right through me
Like I was weather, like I was glass
I had it coming, I know, I know
I made you cry and I let it pass
Now I'm the ghost at the party
You looked right through me
Good for you

[Bridge: drums drop out, falsetto over pads]
I won't come over
I won't say your name
I'll finish this and go

[Final Chorus: everything, falsetto ad-libs, extra synth line]
You looked right through me
Like I was weather, like I was glass
I had it coming, I know, I know
I made you cry and I let it pass
Now I'm the ghost at the party
You looked right through me
Good for you

[Outro: synth hook alone, a door, street noise]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, C major. A steady, mid-tempo, bittersweet glide. Bright sound, heavy heart.

VOICE: Male tenor, smooth, light and clear, with an effortless falsetto in the pre-chorus and bridge. He sings gently and without self-pity. The chorus is doubled. Falsetto ad-libs over the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A bright, simple synthesiser hook with a soft attack. A steady drum machine with a crisp snare and light gated reverb. Pulsing synth bass. Wide, warm pads. A clean, chorus-effected guitar doubling the hook. A second, higher synth line in the final chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the synth hook, drums and bass. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:36 Pre-chorus. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:17 Verse 2. 1:41 Pre-chorus. 1:53 Chorus 2. 2:22 Bridge, no drums, falsetto over pads. 2:36 Final chorus with ad-libs. 3:05 Outro, the hook alone, a door opening and street noise at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s synth-pop in a mid-1980s style: clean, bright and wide, soft-edged synths, vocal smooth and forward.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The two words that end each chorus.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original tells her to save her tears. This man asks for nothing, says she is right, finishes his drink and leaves. That restraint is what the passing of years adds.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hope, a snub, acceptance, a quiet exit.
